name: Long blue wig
description: A costume wig of straight, bright blue synthetic hair that falls well past the shoulders, with a blunt fringe at the front.
notes: Sitting crown up on a round net cap, 190 mm across, with the hair falling 530 mm behind it as a loose hank of three layered locks, the upper ones shorter; darker strands mark the locks. The model shows the hair laid out long. Slot `hair` as the earlier hair pieces, since a wig sits under a hat; Deadvox has no wig slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Clown nose
description: A round red nose that pinches onto the end of your own, with a squeaker inside.
notes: A 40 mm red ball with a slit at the back where it grips the nose. Honking has no content field. Slot `nose` as the nose rings in earlier jewellery batches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Clown wig
description: A bald pink crown ringed with big puffs of curls in every bright colour there is.
notes: Sitting crown up, 300 mm across: a pink crown with a ring of curls round the back and two big side puffs in red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. The curls are modelled as solid balls round a hollow cap. Slot `hair` as the long wig. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Golden crown
description: A gold crown worked with a ring of small flowering trees, red stones set as blossoms in their branches and in the band between them.
notes: Standing upright, 190 mm across and 95 mm tall: a 40 mm band between raised rims with eight trees rising from it. The crown is a hollow ring. Slot `head` as the cardboard crown. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Survivor's crown
description: A heavy gold crown with eight tall points, each tipped with a ball, and a band set round with red, blue and green stones.
notes: Its own model, distinct from the golden crown: 200 mm across and 115 mm tall, a 45 mm band with sixteen stones and eight stepped points. The crown is a hollow ring. Slot `head` as the golden crown. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Identity tags
description: Two stamped steel tags on a ball chain, carrying a soldier's name, number and blood group.
notes: Lying flat: the ball chain in a loop 180 mm across with two 50 by 29 mm tags at the front, the second on its own short loop of chain. The chain lies open in a ring. A per-item owner name has no content field yet. Slot `neck` as the necklaces in earlier jewellery batches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Mouthguard
description: A moulded plastic guard that fits over the upper teeth to save them from a blow to the jaw.
notes: Lying flat, 70 mm across: a clear blue horseshoe channel open on top, with a darker tether tab at the front. The model is the guard alone, without its case. Slot `teeth` as the grills in earlier jewellery batches, the slot that sits in the mouth. Protection is a guess for the teeth only. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bow tie
description: A black silk bow tie, already tied, on an adjustable band.
notes: Lying flat: a 130 mm bow with pleated wings and a wrapped knot, its neckband laid out in a loop behind with a sliding adjuster. The band lies open in a loop. Slot `neck`: the tie clip took `collar`, and a bow tie sits round the neck where necklaces go. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur-lined sleeping bag
description: A quilted sleeping bag lined with fur, with a hood and a side zip, laid open.
notes: Laid out flat and open, 2 m long and 800 mm across the shoulders: an olive quilted shell tapering to the foot, a rounded hood, a black zip down the right side and the top corner turned back to show the pale fur lining. Its own model as the open state; the rolled bag is `rolled_fur_lined_sleeping_bag`. Rolling and unrolling has no content field yet. The model is the bag laid out. Slot `cloak`, the slot for things worn over everything, since the bag covers the whole body; Deadvox has no sleeping-bag slot, and a bedding slot or sleep use may suit it better. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rolled fur-lined sleeping bag
description: A fur-lined sleeping bag rolled tight and held with two straps, with a carry strap to sling it on your back or lash it to a pack.
notes: Lying on its side, 450 mm long and 260 mm across: the olive shell wound round the fur, which shows in rings on the ends, two black compression straps with buckles and a carry strap over the top. Its own model as the rolled state of `fur_lined_sleeping_bag`. Slot `back` as the back bags, and `fits: ["lash"]` so it can ride on a pack's straps instead. A rolled bag on the back keeps nobody warm. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rolled sleeping bag
description: A sleeping bag rolled tight and held with two straps, with a carry strap to sling it on your back or lash it to a pack.
notes: Lying on its side, 400 mm long and 200 mm across: a navy shell wound round a grey flannel lining that shows in rings on the ends, two black compression straps with buckles and a carry strap over the top. Its own model as the rolled state of the open `sleeping_bag`, which is not in this batch. Slot `back` and `fits: ["lash"]` as the fur-lined roll. A rolled bag on the back keeps nobody warm. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Tarpaulin
description: A sheet of tough blue plastic with metal grommets along its edges for tying it down.
notes: Folded into a 400 by 300 mm stack, 60 mm thick, the top fold showing a darker reinforced hem with three galvanised grommets and a corner patch. Slot `cloak` as the ponchos, since it is worn draped over everything. Use as a shelter or groundsheet has no content field yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Arm tefillin
description: A small black leather box holding parchment scrolls, on a long leather strap that is bound round the arm and hand for morning prayer.
notes: Laid out as it is put away: a 32 mm black cube on a 44 mm base, a loop at the back where the strap passes and a small knot beside it, the long strap wound in a flat coil beside the box with its end trailing. The model is `tefillin_arm`, shared with the version for the right arm. Slot `arms` as the arm guards; choosing a side has no content field. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Arm tefillin (right arm)
description: A small black leather box holding parchment scrolls, on a long leather strap, made to be bound round the right arm by someone who writes with the left.
notes: Rides on `tefillin_arm`: laid out coiled, the right-arm version looks the same as the left, with the knot tied the other way. Slot `arms` as the left-arm version; which arm it goes on has no content field. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Head tefillin
description: A small black leather box of four compartments holding parchment scrolls, on a leather strap that is tied round the head so the box sits above the forehead during morning prayer.
notes: Laid out flat: a 30 mm box of four ridged compartments on a 40 mm base, threaded on a strap loop sized to the head and knotted at the back, the two long ends trailing behind, 660 mm overall. The strap lies open. Slot `hair` as the headbands, since it is worn over a skullcap, which takes `head`. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
